flags.why: Bòng bong means tangled bamboo shavings left from whittling, not the strips used to weave baskets ([source](https://tuancongthuphong.blogspot.com/2016/12/mo-cha-khong-khoc-khoc-ong-moi.html)).
flags.fix: Người thợ gom bòng bong lại sau khi vót nan tre. = The craftsman gathers the bamboo shavings after whittling the bamboo strips.

flags.why: Trúng kế is also used in ordinary conversation about being tricked, so the literary tag misleadingly restricts its use ([example](https://vietnamnet.vn/lazada-bi-khach-hang-to-lua-dao-5-buoc-i390617.html)).
In this food sense, lườn refers to belly meat rather than any fish fillet ([source](https://www.lottemart.vn/vi-gvp/product/luon-ca-hoi-tam-uop-400g-2297950000008-p87583)).
Lườn cá hồi denotes salmon belly, which is a different cut from a generic salmon fillet ([source](https://www.lottemart.vn/vi-gvp/product/luon-ca-hoi-tam-uop-400g-2297950000008-p87583)).
flags.fix: I ordered a portion of grilled salmon belly.

flags.why: This sense denotes the submerged part of a boat's hull, rather than specifically its keel ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Dn)).
The Vietnamese describes damage to the boat's underwater hull without specifying the keel ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/l%C6%B0%E1%BB%9Dn)).
flags.fix: The boat's underwater hull was damaged after the storm.

flags.why: Nói ất giáp cái giống gì is an unnatural construction; the expression normally occurs with not knowing or understanding anything ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E1%BA%A5t_gi%C3%A1p)).
flags.fix: Tôi chẳng hiểu ất giáp gì về chuyện này. = I don't understand anything at all about this matter.

flags.why: Cả buổi means the whole session or stretch of the day and does not specify morning.
flags.fix: The little girl chattered away the whole time.
